resources.title: CIA Triad Asset Assessment
resources.short_description: Prioritize confidentiality, integrity, and availability requirements for a specific information asset.
resources.purpose: Create a concise, evidence-oriented record of an asset's security needs and translate those needs into accountable control actions.
resources.when_to_use: Use during asset onboarding, architecture review, risk assessment, major change planning, or after an incident reveals unclear protection priorities.
instructions: Define one asset and its business context.
Rate and justify each CIA objective using evidence and realistic impact scenarios.
Record existing safeguards, gaps, owners, and target dates.
Review the result with the asset owner and update it after material change.
framework_alignment: NIST Cybersecurity Framework 2.0: Identify and Protect outcomes
NIST SP 800-53 Rev. 5 security objectives and control families
resources.disclaimer: Original Joseph Technologies companion material. It is not an official NIST form, is not endorsed by any standards body, does not provide certification, and is not legal or compliance advice.
